additional_info.body:
DC1 has permanent CableTempSensor error. DC1 is Phoenix Cable 375A 5m, possible detachment of PT1000 for quality issue.
Onsite visit required for PT1000 measurements and cable replacement.
Waiting on Prod Care to know which spare part needs to be ordered in replacement of Phoenix 375A 5m (Q-Feedback release blocked).

additional_info.subject: 0455118 - ID0455118-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / S6 170003726] Outlet 1 faulted CRM:00314000236
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0455118
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue:
Customer: Tank&Rast
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset:
AH5065DC011
Charger ID / Serial No.:
MP / S6 170003726
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Reason to Handover
: The charger sends to the OCPP Backend the following vendor code: "evse is not ready" referred to outlet 1. I checked on AWS, and outlet 1 has been OoO since few weeks with CableTempSensor error on DC1. I checked the configuration, and the cable of DC1 should be a Phoenix 375A 5m. On this type of cable, there is an ongoing quality issue, where one or both PT1000 are detaching when the cable is fully extended, resulting in a permanent error flag (as it is).
Last week, the
Q-Feedback
Q2512
related to this topic has been released.
Therefore, it is required to go onsite, verify that the case is the one described by the Q-Feedback,  and perform the repair instructions according to the Q-Feedback. Here is the link:
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109987903
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-DE  SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
eMobility Customer Service
Siemens AG
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
